title: Audit flow: event sources to the joined timeline
lede: Six sources each log in their own shape. A normalizer gives them one envelope, a hash-chained store keeps them, three read-only audit tools query them, and the join stitches one timeline per action. Simulated: every event is synthetic and seeded.

nodes.label: Event sources
sub: idp, token, gateway, policy, hitl, killswitch

nodes.label: Join / timeline
sub: who did what, through which agent

steps.title: Emit
steps.what: Six sources each log in their own shape. None of them knows about the others.

steps.title: Normalize
steps.what: One envelope, with the W3C trace id parsed strictly. A bad traceparent is flagged, never trusted.

steps.title: Store
steps.what: Appended to a hash chain. Edit, delete, insert or reorder and verify fails.

steps.title: Query
steps.what: Three read-only tools. A window past retention is clamped and said so, never silently emptied.

steps.title: Join
steps.what: Correlation ids stitch the timeline. Orphans and gaps are shown, not guessed.
